description: baseline: LightGBM with 5-fold stratified CV + feature engineering (Title extraction, FamilySize, HasCabin/Deck, missingness indicators) chosen because N=891 < 10k tabular data with mixed numeric/categorical features strongly favors gradient boosting over deep learning

Switch to OOF 10-fold CV on all 891 samples (vs 178-sample holdout), add title-based age imputation, AgeBin, FarePerPerson/LogFare, Pclass×Sex interaction, and tune LightGBM params (num_leaves=63, lr=0.02, 3000 trees)
Add Ticket/Family/Name features + blend LightGBM+XGBoost+CatBoost OOF ensemble for model diversity

Add OOF target encoding for 6 categorical features (avoids leakage), add semantic "women and children first" features (IsChild, IsMother, IsWomanOrChild, IsAdultMale, Fare_WomanChild), add ExtraTrees as 4th model for GBM diversity, and add a proper stacking meta-learner (logistic regression on OOF predictions via nested CV)
